# Badges of the README

Own design (no shields.io), made by `source/make.js`:

```bash
node .github/badges/source/make.js .github/badges .github/badges/source/icons
```

Change a label, value or colour in the `list` of `make.js` and run it again.

Icons:
- Discord and C++: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/) (CC0 1.0). The marks belong to their owners.
- Globe, book, download, ship, Windows, scale: [Tabler Icons](https://tabler.io/icons), MIT License,
  Copyright (c) 2020-2024 Paweł Kuna.
